axes: Blender coords: -Y = muzzle/forward, +Z = up, -X = shooter's right (ejection port side), +X = left. GLB is exported +Y up, so glTF = (x, z, -y).

Grip.note: rotated +22 deg about X so local +Z runs up the grip axis

Muzzle.note: tip of flash hider; fire direction is -Y

Sight.note: rear flip-up sight aperture (iron sight line, co-aligned with front post); aim along -Y

MagWell.note: top center of the magazine where it seats; Magazine mesh is placed here

model: AR-15 pattern short-barrel carbine, 10.5in barrel, free-float handguard, flip-up sights, minimalist stock (original mesh, no markings except SAFE/SEMI/FULL)
export_note: 2026-11-05: GLB re-exported at stud scale (x3.6, empties too) with a barrel, gas tube and front cap added inside the handguard; meta locations below are still the original meters.
